notes.title: Devlog
notes.content:
Hey! It's been a while since our last post, so here we are! 

Sign up for upcoming playtest on our game's page!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1473180/This_is_Timmy/


Current state of the game:
The game is fully playable, right now we are working on levels and preparing everything for final playtest. 

What we have so far:

Updated main menu, we tried many variants of menu and this one sticks to our hearts the most! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41041526/c299574ffd539edab7de3665a553b83b6537791d.png


Added level selector UI
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41041526/5dfbfe15ecd90b612ec4c107e04dc0e4b44833b9.png


Added feature of selecting face color and added ingame inventory of unlocked hats for you Timmy!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41041526/429f87a9188d94fad38b2f4906f6e2eb5797bd42.png


Added multiplayer UI, now you can host public or private game for 2, 3 and 4 players!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41041526/9db63e27f1546aeb217510d94dd140427f4b6090.png


Added level selector for multiplayer lobby, now Host can select levels based on amount of players in a lobby! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41041526/f3c3b49f83d711833873efc59eff5afdd640c4ed.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41041526/04c3f14362d722e68753cbff0c2e4fd3be984ff8.png


Added ping ability for multiplayer, players can choose one of four different pings, such as "warning", "look here", "go here" and countdown ping
https://media.giphy.com/media/sDqKpcpJryZVra3hxs/giphy-downsized-large.gif


Added subtitles for voice lines in test chamber + Added tutorial hints!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41041526/dbc8cb5cb405283d6608d07653795dab9f1d45f7.png

Thank you for reading this post! Follow for more and don't forget to wishlist This is Timmy on steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1473180/This_is_Timmy/

notes.title: News blog
notes.content:
What's new? 
We are preparing for new playtest, with the help of social medias, a lot of cool players have appeared in our community, thank you all for your help and feedback!


 The plot is completely finished and now we are working on cutscenes and story levels
 All popular bugs have been fixed, thanks to all the participants of our wonderful discord server for their help! (the bug with the button is here, let it be a feature, you really liked it!)
 Added skins! Now you can paint your Timmy in 16 new colors! And choose a cute hat for him
 MULTIPLAYER! Finally! It is still in development, everything works smoothly, there are a couple of bugs, but we will fix them soon, there will be multiplayer in the beta test!
 Minor bug fixes


Dont forget to wishlist the game!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1473180/This_is_Timmy/

 Your artworks!! 
Thank you very much everyone, you draw very cool!

notes.title: Demo update 0.333
notes.content:
Update v.0.333 is live now! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41041526/21774f0bf2a6fee3365c83557bec857ef7efff2b.png
Some small hot-fixes, tweaks, and new bugs already! How exciting!

Changes-list:
-Fixed kill zones
-Added audio reverbs
-Added cubekiller
-Added new checkpoint on level 3
-Tweaks in level geometry
-Added sound effect for wooden box on first cutscene
-Minor changes


Let us know in our discord what you think about new rocket launcher!
Have fun, gamers!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1473180/This_is_Timmy/
